environment.runtime: Docker 29.4.0 (Version: 2.2.3 (2020300)); oha 1.16.0 in a container on the engine's Docker network

protocol.processModel: One engine container at a time (4 CPUs, 4 GB); PostGIS in its own 6-CPU container; the client container on the same Docker network
protocol.cacheState: Server tile caches off; PMTiles directory caches at go-pmtiles' 64 MB default; PostgreSQL buffer cache prewarmed
protocol.output: Tiles decoded and counted per server before timing (parity); every sample in this file

sections.title: PostGIS: Single tile, one client
sections.deck: One client, one tile at a time over one keep-alive connection; the samples are the mean of each measured pass, pooled over the four test tiles.

verdict.headline: Martin 1.16.1: 6.12 ms. Martin 2.0.0 does not win it handily: Martin 1.16.1 is best.
